requirements.requirement: Stateful local closures and non-Send values
requirements.comparison: Divan 0.1.21 benchmark/mod.rs bench_local, bench_local_values and bench_local_refs accept FnMut with no Send requirement. Suite bench/bench_with_owned_input/bench_with_input accept borrowed FnMut closures and non-Send inputs/outputs; tests verify repeated runs, samples, batches, lazy registration and mutable stack borrows. Criterion iter/iter_batched/iter_batched_ref have the same local closure capability. Drop policy is independently selectable.

requirements.requirement: Fresh mutable input, setup and input destruction excluded
requirements.comparison: Criterion 0.8.2 iter_batched_ref constructs inputs before timer and drops them after timer; Divan 0.1.21 bench_refs/bench_local_refs borrow generated inputs and destroy after outputs. Airbug tests freshness, mutation, exact setup/drop counts, work interval inclusion and setup/drop exclusion across sync, async, coordinator workers, local workers and async workers, with multiple samples and batch remainders.

requirements.requirement: Fresh input moved into operation, setup excluded
Per-iteration, fixed batch, number of batches and memory policies
requirements.comparison: Criterion 0.8.2 BatchSize has SmallInput ceil(n/10), LargeInput ceil(n/1000), PerIteration=1, NumBatches ceil(n/k), NumIterations=k. Airbug maps these to SmallInput/LargeInput/PerIteration/Batches/Iterations with nonzero counts. The integration matrix verifies peak live input/output counts, leftovers and drop across samples for all sync/async owned/borrowed combinations. These limit object counts, not heap bytes; threaded custom batch policy is an Airbug extension gap, not a Criterion BatchSize feature.

requirements.requirement: Deferred output destruction including large outputs
requirements.comparison: Criterion 0.8.2 Bencher/AsyncBencher::iter_with_large_drop delegates to batched unit input with SmallInput. Airbug supports the same batching choice and explicit outside drop for plain/setup sync/async work. Divan 0.1.21 lib.rs Drop documentation and benchmark/mod.rs defer output destruction, including zero-sized outputs, until after synchronized timers stop. Airbug verifies this for coordinator/local/async workers; it defaults to inside drop, offers bounded waves, and cleans retained values on unwind. API/default compatibility is not required.

requirements.requirement: Reusable setup context outside measured iterations
requirements.comparison: Reusable state captured outside Criterion iteration loops or Divan Bencher sample loops maps to Suite local closures and Fixture. The fixture test proves one lazy initialization outside measurement, shared mutation across cases/samples, and destruction once after the final owner. Local closure tests cover non-static stack-borrowed contexts.

requirements.requirement: User-controlled measurement boundaries and duration
requirements.comparison: Criterion 0.8.2 sync/async iter_custom forwards iteration count and records caller return separately from elapsed wall time. Airbug duration path preserves that distinction, completes pending futures, and roundtrips exact u128 nanoseconds. General non-duration M::Value support belongs to the separate measurement requirement, which remains partial.
